title: Collision probability input and presentation integrity validation
objective: Audit and validate the existing Foster Pc workflow, including CDM and research-scenario inputs, event identity, unavailable states, and frontend/report presentation. No scientific calculation redesign.

workflow_audit.step: Physical event and TCA state provenance
workflow_audit.finding: Event Pc inputs are applied to an identified physical assessment event. Validation binds physics event ID, ordered primary/secondary object IDs, UTC TCA, state object IDs, state frame and units, state epochs, and state-derived separation to the stored miss distance. CDM inputs additionally require exact object membership, matching event TCA, matching covariance epochs, and a common covariance frame.

workflow_audit.step: Foster Pc calculation and uncertainty contract
workflow_audit.finding: The existing Foster 2D Gaussian encounter-plane integration remains unchanged. It validates covariance shape, finite values, symmetry, positive definiteness, units, frame, epoch, object identity, and HBR provenance/value. It requires an explicit independent-covariances assumption. The scenario endpoint marks covariance/HBR synthetic and user-entered. Imported CDM originator/source labels are disclosed as unauthenticated.

CDM and scenario Pc endpoints resolve the requested event from the exact completed screening job before applying inputs. Input validation errors return 422. Regression coverage checks a malformed event state epoch is rejected and the stored scenario Pc remains null.

Source CDM Pc and research-scenario Pc remain separate. UI numeric values are gated on available status and finite in-range Pc. The summary now also displays method/version, dimensionless units, source/covariance frame and epoch provenance, HBR provenance, and warnings. Report exports preserve source and scenario status/provenance separately and emit blank/unavailable values rather than substituting zero.

reproduced_defects.reproduction: On a deterministic physical_event fixture, changing a TCA state object ID, epoch, or frame still allowed apply_scenario_inputs to return an available Pc (2.4382718084254695e-06). This let scenario covariance assumptions be evaluated against inconsistent event geometry metadata.
reproduced_defects.correction: The shared event-input validator now checks event and ordered object identity; UTC TCA and matching state epochs; state object IDs, frame and units; finite three-component position/velocity vectors; and agreement between state separation and available km miss distance. It rejects inconsistent inputs with stable reason codes. The Foster calculation itself was not changed.

critical_cases.event_identity_and_job_binding: Existing API tests in test_cdm_ingestion.py verify event resolution within a job and reject mismatched imported object designators. Scenario payload hashing includes event ID, UTC TCA, and frame. The new shared validator rejects physics/event and ordered object identity inconsistencies.
critical_cases.missing_malformed_or_mismatched_state: Existing collision-probability tests cover unavailable and invalid inputs; new event-input tests exercise state object ID, epoch, frame/units, vector, and miss-distance inconsistencies. API state-epoch regression expects 422 and no computed scenario result.
critical_cases.covariance_epoch_frame_units_and_hbr: Existing test_collision_probability.py covers frame/epoch/unit mismatch, covariance validity, HBR validity, missing inputs, explicit independence assumptions, and method applicability. CDM ingestion tests cover parsed covariance and event association.
critical_cases.source_vs_scenario_pc_and_unavailable_va: Existing report-status tests cover available and unavailable source/scenario combinations and no substitution of zero. UI tests confirm values remain separately labeled and unavailable values are not rendered numerically.
critical_cases.warnings_and_applicability: UI rendering regression verifies warnings and provenance remain visible alongside the status. Foster applicability and input warnings continue to be returned by the unchanged calculation service.
critical_cases.screening_job_terminal_statuses: Not invoked as part of this Pc-specific validation. Screening lifecycle and event/job status handling were exercised and reported in Phase 12.6; this phase adds no job execution.

no_inference_and_execution_controls.downstream_esa_prediction_and_anomaly_ho: No screening invocation occurred. Pc-focused tests call event-input, Foster, API TestClient, and report/UI code paths without invoking screening or AI assessment hooks.

browser_behavior.detail: Frontend behavior was checked with rendering tests and a production build. No browser session or interactive UI inspection was run.

limitations: Validation used deterministic offline fixtures and mocked API job storage, not operational screening archives or live CDM providers.
CDM source labels are user-declared and not authenticated by this application; imported covariance and HBR remain subject to source uncertainty.
Foster Pc uses its existing local-linear Gaussian and explicit independence assumptions; these tests establish software input and presentation behavior, not model adequacy for a real conjunction.
A scenario Pc is a research result from user-entered assumptions and does not demonstrate collision-risk reduction, maneuver effectiveness, or operational safety.
No live browser behavior was inspected.
